methodology.title: Our research, your clarity.
methodology.description: Our method for verifying insurer wording, distinguishing legal minimum from extended coverage and handling annual travel limits.

blocks.x: BorderCover Atlas compares published insurer and government information. It does not confirm that your personal policy is active or approve a claim.
What a result means

Published overseas cover means the source describes equivalent purchased policy cover in the listed territory, subject to exclusions, limits and your issued documents. Legal liability, own-car damage/theft, breakdown/recovery and required documents are assessed separately. Unresearched benefits and insufficient evidence are never permission to drive.
Counting a journey

Annual allowances include entered previous usage. Per-trip allowances apply to one journey. Unknown usage and unresolved renewal counting prevent a definitive unused-allowance calculation. Departure and return days are counted inclusively. A renewal crossing is flagged; no automatic renewed allowance or policy-edition continuity is assumed.

Up to five declared destination or transit countries can be compared. The full trip duration applies conservatively to every listed stop, while the journey is counted once. Undeclared transit countries are outside the result.
Dates and evidence

The imported research snapshot is dated 2026-11-01. Source records retain their imported dates and review notes; these do not establish a named human verification. Exact automated observations carry a separate retrieval date. Missing policy editions, quotations, reviewer names and review deadlines are shown as missing.

Automated source retrieval can detect a changed, blocked or unavailable page. It does not certify legal accuracy, reset human review dates or change published insurance rules. The editorial register shows approved revisions separately; updates to rules require a reviewed dataset change and regression tests.
Editorial accountability

The application owner, named lead reviewer and review response times have not been supplied. These remain public-launch requirements. Consequential evidence approval requires a different authorized reviewer from the draft author. Issue reports and unlisted-insurer requests are stored privately for authorized reviewers; receiving a report does not establish that a reviewer has acted on it.
Research scope

The register includes six markets, named insurer profiles and generic fallback profiles. Every market remains a research preview until its material rules have accountable claim-level review. AA France and Ireland have recorded automated quotations, not human approvals.
Independence and limits

This release does not quote, sell or bind insurance and includes no paid rankings or affiliate tracking links. Confirm your policy schedule, tier, drivers, route, travel dates, endorsements, business use and destination law with your insurer. Legal assessment of launch-market wording remains outstanding.

privacy.title: Private by default. No account needed.
privacy.description: How trip selections, fragment-based sharing, correction reports and reviewer accounts are handled.

blocks.x: Public coverage checks need no account. Scenario calculations use the bundled research data. Do not enter policy numbers, vehicle registration numbers or identity documents.
Trip links

Share creates a URL fragment containing the research release identifier, selected market, insurer, plan, countries, days, previous usage and any entered travel dates. An unavailable historical release is not silently replayed against current rules. Anyone holding the link can read those inputs. Fragments are not normally sent in web requests to the host, but people can copy or disclose them. Share only what you are comfortable revealing.
Correction reports

Sending an issue report stores its text, rule reference, rule version and timestamp in Lovable Cloud. Reports are available only to authorized reviewers. Do not include personal or sensitive information. Editorial response times and a named contact have not yet been established.
Reviewer accounts

Reviewer sign-in is powered by Lovable Cloud. Creating an account does not grant review permissions. Email/password and supported social providers process sign-in details under their own terms. Review revisions record a supplied public reviewer name, evidence and dates; private account identifiers are not exposed in the public evidence register.
Hosting and external sites

Hosting and error-monitoring services may process ordinary connection and diagnostic information. The app does not intentionally send trip inputs to analytics. External source links open publisher websites with their own privacy practices. Automated source checks use fixed public publisher URLs, not your personal trip details.
Contact and retention
A named privacy contact and documented report/account retention period are still required before public launch. No invented contact address or deletion-response promise is provided.

Not an insurance quotation or proof of coverage

No result is an active-policy lookup, guarantee, renewal certificate, legal opinion or a substitute for destination insurance requirements. Do not start a trip in reliance on this tool alone. Confirm benefits and documents with the insurer and relevant country authorities.
This website is a general-information tool. It does not issue insurance, verify your personal policy, bind an insurer, sell a contract or decide whether a claim is covered.
Not financial or legal advice

Descriptions are based on selected publicly accessible insurer and government sources checked on the date shown. They may be incomplete, change without notice or differ from your personal schedule, endorsements, state or provincial law, vehicle registration, driver status, trip purpose and route.
Your duty to verify

Before driving abroad, obtain your current insurance certificate, policy wording and any required documentary extension. Confirm the destination and all transit countries with the insurer. Verify the legal liability, Green Card, temporary import, roadworthiness and registration rules that apply in each country. Do not start a trip relying only on an automated result.
Use and accuracy

The service is provided on an information-only basis, without a guarantee of completeness or uninterrupted availability. To the extent permitted by law, the publisher is not responsible for decisions taken without verification against binding insurance documents or applicable law. Nothing here removes any statutory consumer rights.
Names and trademarks
Insurer names are used only for factual comparison and attribution. No insurer is represented as a partner, sponsor or endorser of BorderCover Atlas.
Affiliate status
This release contains no affiliate tracking links, sponsored insurer rankings, price quotes or lead capture. If this changes, the relevant relationships must be disclosed.
